title: cleanup_tmp_files deletes any *.tmp, not just queue tmp files
description: The round-6 change replaced ends_with('.msg.tmp')||ends_with('.env.tmp') with extension()=="tmp". Path::extension() returns the last dot-separated component, so 'anything.tmp' matches — not just 'something.msg.tmp' or 'something.env.tmp'. If an operator places a lock file or monitoring probe (e.g. 'health.tmp') in the queue directory, cleanup_tmp_files silently deletes it at startup. The old two-condition check was semantically precise about exactly which file shapes the queue creates; the new check is a broader contract that deletes any .tmp file regardless of origin.
